title: Bunkie
subtitle: Roommate & Housing Discovery
overview: Bunkie is a roommate and shared-housing discovery platform designed to make finding compatible roommates and affordable accommodation easier, safer and more reliable. The platform connects people searching for accommodation with individuals who have available rooms, while helping users discover potential roommates based on lifestyle preferences, budget, location and personal compatibility. The work covers the full interface across onboarding and profile creation, roommate discovery, housing discovery, messaging and dashboard.
problem: Finding shared accommodation in Nigeria often involves navigating fragmented and unreliable channels. People typically depend on property agents, Facebook groups, WhatsApp communities and social media posts, which introduces high agency fees, trust and safety concerns, poor roommate compatibility, scattered information and time-consuming searches. Bunkie needed a clear, trustworthy mobile-first experience that simplified roommate and housing discovery.
solution: A mobile-first UI covering onboarding and profile creation, roommate discovery, housing discovery, messaging and dashboard. Structured compatibility preferences were paired with traditional housing filters, verification indicators and a unified flow to help users find affordable accommodation and compatible roommates with confidence.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content:
Bunkie is a roommate and shared-housing discovery platform designed to make finding compatible roommates and affordable accommodation easier, safer and more reliable.

The platform connects people searching for accommodation with individuals who have available rooms, while helping users discover potential roommates based on lifestyle preferences, budget, location and personal compatibility.

Finding a place to live is challenging enough. Finding someone compatible to share that space with makes the process even more complicated. Bunkie was created so finding a place to live and someone to live with feels less stressful and more reassuring.

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.content:
Finding a place to live is challenging enough. Finding someone compatible to share that space with makes the process even more complicated.

To better understand the problem, the team conducted UX research with prospective users across Lagos, Ilorin, Bauchi and Port Harcourt. The research included students, NYSC members and young professionals with previous experience searching for shared accommodation.

Key research insights

- Affordability is a major concern, with expensive agency fees and limited affordable housing options among the most frequently reported frustrations.
- Trust is essential, with concerns about fake listings, financial scams and the difficulty of verifying potential roommates.
- Finding accommodation takes time, with many respondents spending more than a month securing their current accommodation.
- Compatibility goes beyond location and budget, covering cleanliness, lifestyle habits, noise levels, personality, security and work or study schedules.

What this meant for the design

- Simplify housing and roommate discovery.
- Make compatibility information accessible during the discovery process.
- Introduce trust-building elements that help users make informed decisions.

sections.title: Design Thinking: Define
sections.content:
The product was designed around three primary user groups.

- The New City Graduate: a young professional relocating to a new city who needs affordable accommodation and a compatible roommate without relying entirely on unfamiliar agents or social networks.
- The Budget-Conscious Student: a student searching for affordable accommodation close to school, with a roommate whose lifestyle and routines align with theirs.
- The Room Lister: an existing tenant or homeowner looking for a responsible person to share an available room or apartment.

The core product experience was structured around six major capabilities.

- User onboarding and profile creation.
- Room and roommate listings.
- Search and filtering.
- User profiles and verification.
- Roommate compatibility discovery.
- In-app messaging.

A proposed booking request flow was designed to help users express interest in available accommodation.

sections.title: Design Thinking: Ideate
sections.content:
How Might We

- How might we make finding the right roommate feel less stressful?
- How might we help users find affordable accommodation without high agency fees?
- How might we make compatibility information accessible during discovery?
- How might we build trust before users commit to a shared living arrangement?
- How might we reduce the time and effort of finding shared accommodation?

Directions

- Simplify housing and roommate discovery into one connected experience.
- Combine lifestyle preferences with traditional housing filters such as location, price, room type and availability.
- Introduce trust-building elements through user profiles and verification.
- Sequence roommate compatibility discovery before connecting users for messaging.

sections.title: Design Strengths
sections.content:
Finding accommodation is not simply about finding an available room. It also involves affordability, personal safety, lifestyle compatibility and the confidence to share a living space with another person.

Bunkie reinforced an important aspect of product design: solving the problem requires understanding the decisions people make beyond the immediate task. It also highlighted the importance of collaboration between UX, UI, product management and brand design in building a coherent product experience.
